description: Generate a deep link to a curated Event Escapes PACKAGE detail page (/packages/{slug}). Packages are hand-curated bundles of event tickets + hotel + experiences with savings vs DIY booking. Takes a package_id or slug returned by search_packages. This does not make a reservation: the user reviews tier, duration and guest selectors and books on the package page.

guests.description: Number of travellers as stated by the user. Optional, with no default.

name: build_package_link
